clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Klockmort Spannerspan needs components left behind in Gnomeregan. The exiled gnomes fled their city during the trogg invasion and radiation disaster, leaving supplies of essential artificials in its lower halls.

When troggs overran Gnomeregan and radiation filled its corridors, fleeing gnomes carried only what they could reach. Supplies of essential artificials remained behind. These specialized mechanical parts work in nearly any device, and tinkers and crafters prize them. Now based in Ironforge's Tinker Town, master tinker Klockmort Spannerspan cannot continue his new experiments without them.

The components are kept in heavy, steam-powered containers called artificial extrapolators, deep inside Gnomeregan. Reaching them means crossing irradiated halls where mutated leper gnomes, malfunctioning defense automatons, and feral troggs roam. Klockmort needs twelve components to continue his work and keep gnomish invention moving despite the exile.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A nigh-universal mechanical component--the essential artificial--was of great use to the tinkers and smiths of Gnomeregan. But during the frantic exodus from our city, no one remembered to take any of these devices with them! And I need a large supply of them for work I will soon undertake.
Please, go into Gnomeregan and get me some essential artificials. You'll find them in the deeper areas of our city, held in containers called artificial extrapolators.
Thank you, friend, and please hurry!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the essential artificials?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got them! Now I can begin my new experiments!
I can't thank you enough, friend! You're bravery has advanced gnomish research by a leap and a bound!
